# RAND Corporation

> RAND is a nonprofit think tank providing objective research, policy analysis, and strategic insights on defense, international relations, veterans policy, education, and public affairs.

RAND Corporation conducts research across multiple domains including U.S.-China competition, military strategy, veterans support, education equity, and international development. The organization operates regional offices and centers focused on specific policy areas, with expertise in defense, Asia-Pacific strategy, and domestic policy challenges.

## Key Topics

- Policy analysis and research
- U.S.-China competition
- Veterans policy and benefits
- Military strategy and defense
- International relations
- Asia-Pacific strategy
- Education equity
- Pandemic preparedness
- Policy Lab initiatives
- Army research
- Belt and Road Initiative
- Veteran-serving organizations
- Public opinion research
- Disaster resilience
- AI and technology exports

## Core Research & Analysis

- [RAND Corporation Homepage](https://www.rand.org): RAND Corporation homepage: nonprofit think tank providing policy research and analysis on defense, international relations, veterans policy, and public affairs.
- [International Relations Research](https://www.rand.org/zh-hans/publications/international-relations.html): RAND research on international relations, US-China competition, and geopolitical analysis.
- [RAND in China](https://www.rand.org/zh-hans/rand-in-china.html): RAND Corporation's research collaborations and projects in China.
- [RAND Australia Research & Commentary](https://www.rand.org/australia/research-and-commentary.html): RAND Australia research on health, defense, education, and economic development.

## Veterans Policy & Support

- [Policy Lab: Supporting Veterans After the Yellow Ribbons Fade](https://www.rand.org/events/2023/11/policy-lab-supporting-veterans-after-the-yellow-ribbons-fade.html): RAND Policy Lab mapping veteran policy landscape and support frameworks.
- [Twenty Years of Service: American Perspectives on What We Owe Veterans](https://www.rand.org/events/2021/09/30.html): RAND webinar on American public opinion regarding veterans' benefits and post-war obligations.
- [The Role of Veteran-Serving Nonprofits](https://www.rand.org/events/2023/03/the-role-of-veteran-serving-nonprofits.html): RAND panel discussion on veteran-serving nonprofits and veterans policy initiatives.

## Military Strategy & Defense

- [Policy Lab: Restoring U.S. and Allied Military Power and Influence](https://www.rand.org/events/2025/07/restoring-us-and-allied-military-power-and-influence.html): RAND Policy Lab on reversing erosion of U.S. and allied military power.
- [Army Research Division Leadership](https://www.rand.org/ard/bios.html): RAND Army Research Division leadership directory and staff biographies.
- [Memorial Symposium: Twenty Years of David Johnson's Military Research](https://www.rand.org/events/2023/02/24.html): Memorial symposium honoring RAND researcher Dr. David E. Johnson's military research.

## Emerging Technologies & Geopolitics

- [China's AI Exports](https://www.rand.org/events/2023/12/chinas-ai-export.html): RAND webinar on China's AI export projects and Belt and Road Initiative financing.

## Education & Resilience

- [The Math Equity Equation](https://www.rand.org/events/2024/08/the-math-equity-equation.html): RAND webinar on math equity and student tracking in K-12 public schools.
- [The Impact of Natural Disasters on Education in the United States and its Territories](https://www.rand.org/events/2023/02/impact-of-natural-disasters-on-education.html): RAND webinar exploring effects of natural disasters on education and disaster resilience.

## Health & Pandemic Preparedness

- [Can South Korea Help the World Beat the Next Pandemic?](https://www.rand.org/events/2022/10/13-1.html): RAND webinar on South Korea's COVID-19 response and pandemic preparedness strategies.

## Optional

- [Arroyo Center Publications - Annual Reports](https://www.rand.org/ard/pubs/annual_reports.html): Listing of RAND Arroyo Center annual reports for U.S. Army research.
- [Alumni Impact Fund 2015: Winning Projects](https://www.rand.org/alumni/impact-award/2015-winning-projects.html): RAND alumni-funded research projects on healthcare policy and defense technology.
